label: champ_0045_dragon_02
text: Nemona had mentioned there was a promising\nnew face in the academy—yes, indeed.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: champ_0045_dragon_03
text: Oh, but I do apologize. I didn’t mean to startle\nyou by addressing you so suddenly.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: champ_0045_dragon_04
text: My name is Hassel. I’m one of the Elite Four of\nthe Pokémon League.\c\nI also teach art classes at the academy.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0045_dragon_05
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, do tell me, young [VAR 0x0100(0000)]:
What
compels
you to
collect
these
Gym
Badges
and
strive
to be a
Champion?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0045_dragon_07
text: Naturally there is no single correct answer.\c\nAll paths lead to the Great Crater of Paldea,\nas they say.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0045_dragon_08
text: You know, your friend Nemona is the youngest to\nachieve Champion Rank in all Paldean history...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0045_dragon_09
text: It is entirely possible that such great potential lies\nwithin you as well.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0045_dragon_10
text: Should you continue striving to reach Champion\nRank, you will one day have to battle me.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0045_dragon_11
text: You would be wise to train hard starting now.\nIt will save you from experiencing the bitter\r\nregret of defeat.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0045_dragon_12
text: Oh, and do come along to my art class sometime.\nI would be thrilled to have you attend.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
